newsitem.title: USA: United Foods concludes tender offer.
newsitem.headline: United Foods concludes tender offer.

text.p: United Foods Inc said on Thursday that it accepted for purchase 1.5 million shares of its Class A common stock and 1.5 million shares of its Class B common stock.
The company said the shares were purchased at the tender offer price of $2.50 per share, for a total consideration of $10 million.
The company said tendering shareholders could expect to receive the consideration for their shares shortly.
Other than odd lot shares, tendered shares were accepted on a prorated basis, the company said.
After giving effect to the purchase of the shares, the company said it has outstanding 2.61 million shares of Class A common stock and 4.19 million shares of Class B common stock.
